note: Small private park on KS-63 just south of Emmett; three gravel rows of angled pads, propane on site. Mostly occupied by workers at the nearby plant; campers report it quiet and clean. --Claude
summary: No website (Facebook page live but unreadable logged out); Google 4.6/32 with phone 785-477-5307 = presence; RV Life $ (avg $20) = price; only dated rate is $45 (Campendium, 2021). Reviews and imagery read as a workforce park (full pads, 'reasonable rent', 'here for work at the plant'). Laundry confirmed, showers false (owner's reply). Pin is on the highway ~160 m east of the pads. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE (workforce, test 2): Google reviews are almost all from workers ('3 years ago - We are here for work at the plant'; '8 months ago - close to work very reasonable priced'; '5 years ago - We travel for work'; a resident's 'my backyard has cows'), Google's topic chips list 'reasonable rent', and imagery shows ~40 pads nearly all occupied. As a long-stay park it needs a nightly rate on its own site + phone or a booking site selling one night (test 2); it has neither: no website (Facebook only), no booking engine, and the only dated nightly rate is $45 from a 2021 Campendium review. The RV Life $ tier does not stand in under test 2. On the fence -> drop per AWH 2026-10-31; a human decides.

PRICE: note's '$20/night' rests on RV Life avg_rate 20 (last review 2021); Campendium's only review (2021-04-23) paid $45. No 2024+ rate found; no fees written. Gateway check not needed (both under $50).
